package.description: Export Revit schedules directly to the nullCarbon LCA platform.

en-US.description: Export Revit schedules directly to the nullCarbon LCA platform.
en-US.longDescription:
nullCarbon Revit Export is a per-user Autodesk Revit add-in that exports
schedules straight to the nullCarbon LCA (Life Cycle Assessment) platform.
Supports Revit 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026, and 2027. Installs without admin rights
under %LocalAppData%\nullCarbon-LCA-Export\ and adds a single "nullCarbon"
ribbon tab with the Export button.
en-US.name: nullCarbon Revit Export
